title: Visitors read Theme Kits and Nocturne: the /themes pages, the Nocturne sales page and their SEO titles use the new names
detail: Copy only. "Mega Theme" reads as Theme Kits and the Midnight theme as Nocturne on /themes, /themes/[theme] and the Midnight feature page (themePagePath in lib/themes/library.ts, SEO titles in lib/seo/frequency-pages.ts). Ids, the Midnight editor value, saved site styles and the /themes/midnight address are unchanged. The address and the picker label followed in LIVE-1553 once Daniel released the pins.

verify.evidence: lib/themes/library.ts maps midnight to its Nocturne address; the picker label reads Nocturne.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const f=require("fs");const l=f.readFileSync("lib/themes/library.ts","utf8");const s=f.readFileSync("lib/theme/site-style.ts","utf8");if(!l.includes("nocturne")||!s.includes("label: \x27Nocturne\x27")){console.error("the Nocturne name is gone");process.exit(1)}'
